summary: Full backend + frontend validation of the SUVI INTERIOR luxury redesign + new /brochure page and PDF endpoint. Backend: 15 pytest tests (health, project-types, enquiries CRUD/auth, and 2 new brochure PDF tests validating status=200, application/pdf, Content-Disposition Suvi-Interior-Brochure.pdf, size >500KB, 7 pages via pymupdf, and cached second call) all pass. Frontend Desktop (1920): Home renders hero with h1 'Interiors that feel like home.', font-family h1 = 'Cormorant Garamond, Georgia, serif' and body = 'Plus Jakarta Sans, system-ui, sans-serif'; header/nav/logo/marquee test IDs all present; header class transitions from 'bg-transparent' to include 'glass' after scroll >24px; hero primary CTA navigates to /brochure. Brochure page has all 18 required test IDs, all 6 capability slugs, cover h1 correct, download button href ends with /api/brochure.pdf and download attr='Suvi-Interior-Brochure.pdf', PDF fetch=200, print button visible on desktop. Footer has all 7 required IDs. WhatsApp float visible at 1920. Frontend Mobile (390x844): sticky bar visible with correct tel/wa/brochure hrefs; mobile menu opens with all 10 nav/menu test IDs, closes on navigation; brochure-print-btn hidden on mobile as expected. Zero horizontal overflow on /, /brochure, /services, /contact (scrollWidth=375 <= 390). Regression: /services, /projects, /about, /process, /gallery, /contact all load without console errors; contact form submits and shows contact-success. Zero console errors and no broken images across every page tested.
critical_code_review_comments: PDF is cached in a process-level dict (_pdf_cache) — fine for a marketing site, but there is no cache-bust mechanism if brochure_content.py changes; consider keying by a content hash or clearing on startup only (current behaviour) is acceptable.
Brochure PDF endpoint has no rate limit; a public GET that runs reportlab on cold cache could be a mild DoS vector (mitigated after first request by the in-memory cache).

Header logo text is concatenated with the tagline ('SuviInteriorInterior Design & Furniture · Nashik') when read via textContent — purely a testability nit (contains 'Suvi' and 'Interior' as required), but adding an aria-label on the logo would improve screen-reader clarity.
seed_data_creation: 3 TEST_-prefixed enquiries created via API during pytest run; safe to purge by main agent (all names start with TEST_).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py runs via `pytest backend/tests/backend_test.py -p no:randomly` (2s). New TestBrochurePDF class uses pymupdf (already installed) to assert 7 pages. Frontend hot-reload is on. Note: the intro preloader shows only once per session (sessionStorage 'suvi-intro-seen'); scripts wait ~2.5s after navigation. Contact project-type is a native <select> — use select_option with label='Modular Kitchen'.
